new_value: Iranian NIOC project to liquefy North Pars field gas, distinct from Qatar's North Field expansion (a different project on the Qatari side of the shared structure, tracked at Qatar North Field LNG Terminal). History: CNOOC-NIOC MoU Sep 2006, extended Dec 2006 to a 4-train, 20 mtpa LNG development (China Daily 2006; OGJ 2006: https://www.ogj.com/exploration-development/article/17280439/cnooc-nioc-in-talks-to-develop-north-pars-field); a ~$16bn development contract was reported signed in 2008 but never finalized; last live plan April 2010 (OGJ: construction from 2013, startup 2014, plant in Tombak region: https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/lng/article/17209101/ogj-focus-iranian-lng-natural-gas-export-plans-outlined); CNOOC withdrew as US/EU sanctions ramped in 2011/12 (OilPrice 2021: https://oilprice.com/Energy/Natural-Gas/Iran-To-Join-LNG-Race-In-Asia-With-Huge-North-Pars-Development.html); by June 2013 OIES listed North Pars LNG among MoU projects that made no progress (https://www.oxfordenergy.org/wpcms/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/NG-78.pdf). Shelved 2012 / cancelled 2014 are GEM dormancy inferences off the 2010 last-activity anchor. The pre-2026 record was contaminated with Qatar North Field data (QatarEnergy owner, 32 mtpa, 2018 proposal, offshore-energy.biz ref) — removed in the 2026-06-30 overhaul; do not reintroduce.
